messages:
Hana (Sales): Team — ZenWell evaluation. Must process+store only in UK (europe-west2) and Canada (northamerica-northeast1). BYOK mandatory. They asked for a definitive subprocessor list, a config snippet, and a short list of unavoidable exceptions. Can presales/infra/legal advise? @Evan @Marta @Diego
Evan (Presales): Technically doable via Dedicated-regional or Private. Hosted default control-plane lives in US; if they need zero control-plane crossing we must enable regional control-plane or deploy Private to their VPC. BYOK supported via partner HSM in-region.
Marta (Infra): Config snippet to share:
```yaml
mode: dedicated-regional
regions:
  - europe-west2
  - northamerica-northeast1
control_plane: regional-addon
byok: true
kms: partner-hsm-in-region
telemetry: regional-only
egress_policy: deny-third-country
```
Unavoidable items: OCSP/CRL checks to public CAs, some package repo pulls during provisioning, and rare support tunnels. We can mitigate with local CA proxy and offline packages but add ~5-7 days work.
Diego (Legal): I'll provide DPA addendum and subproc attestation. If ZenWell insists on absolute no-third-country transfers we need signed risk acceptance for cert/CA flows unless we implement the proxy.
Kyle (AE): Pricing ballpark for a small 6-week POC?
Evan (Presales): Estimate: dedicated regional slices + BYOK + ops support ~ $10-13k/month. Private (VPC/on-prem) adds one-time integration (~$8-12k) + ~$6k/mo infra license. Final quote after sizing.
Hana (Sales): Great — I'll send config+exceptions and ask for signed acceptance or request proxy. Will update when ZenWell replies. ops-bot: Ticket INFRA-9122 created for ZenWell subproc export and assigned to Marta.
